Hail to thee, stranger! I am Phillip. I hope you're not here looking for passage to Aridell because I've temporarily shut that service down. It's far too dangerous to be making that run anymore.
Hey there!
I am a boatman. I use my small skiff here to run goods for people to various ports around Thaermore, but I've been forced to end routes because it has become too dangerous.

Traveling by boat is much faster than walking, really. I was making a good living just making short runs between here and Aridell, but even that has become too dangerous. All I can do now is wait for peace to return so that I can get back to work.
I have finished destroying every last Fungal Slime!
Well I cannot thank you enough! Here, take this bit of gold. It's not much, but it is all I have. I'll soon be earning more now that I can resume my route to Aridell.
What makes the route to Aridell so dangerous?
Well, as you see I use a very small boat. I don't take her far out to sea because she isn't built for that kind of travel, but she does very well at running the rip currents near the shoreline.

I used to be able to run the rip currents all the way to Aridell when the tides were coming in, then back here to Bordertown on the outgoing tides. But then the marshes east of here became infested with Fungal Slimes. They would spit at me from the shoreline, and a few times they damn near sunk my boat with their corrosive sludge! However, if I ran my boat far enough from shore to avoid their attacks, I risked getting swept out to sea! So, I just decided to stop doing the route altogether.
Would it be worth anything to you if I were to destroy all the Fungal Slime from the marshlands?
Why yes, it would! I'd happily pay you a reward for your efforts if you were to eliminate those horrid slimes!
It sounds like you are suffering just like everyone else is. Good luck to you.
That sounds like a deal. I'll let you know when all the Slimes are destroyed.
I'm still working on cleaning all the Fungal Slimes out of the Marshes of Boradan.
You, human! Why come you to our village? Giants crush trespassers!
Yes?
I am looking for the tribal leader, Omar. Are you him?
Yes, I keep that name. What wants you, human?
I am a slayer of Giants! Prepare to die!
I am $. I have been sent here by Erubor of Shadowmirk to retrieve a Goblin key. Do you know of what I speak?
Yes human, I know of key. Giants retrieved it after Goblins sneaked into camp. We crushed them into jelly and find key. We keep it.
Erubor be friend of Giants. He send word you would come for key. Why you seek this key? What have you with the Goblins?
I am going to use the key to enter the Goblin Citadel and destroy Gramuk. The Goblin scourge must end!

All goblins enemies of Giants. We support your quest. I will give you Goblin key as Erubor request, but first you do task for Giants. You must show friendship to Giants and then we give you key, and we also help you fight Goblins. Together we crush them little green maggots!
This business does not concern the race of Giants. You would do wise to give me the key as Erubor requested.
Very well human. Erubor our friend, but you are not. I will give you key as favor to Erubor, but Giants will not aid you on your quest.
However, you must first do task for us. Erubor never say we couldn't trade, so we will trade for key. You must retrieve valuable artifact for Giants, then I trade you Goblin key for it.

Great Giant chieftain named Thorus was killed many seasons ago. Human named Thorndike killed him, hunted him like he were animal. Thorndike was much hated Giant slayer. He take chieftain skull back to his hunting camp in the north and display as trophy. Now Chieftain soul cannot rest until skull has been returned.

You retrieve chieftain's skull from Thorndike camp and return with it so we can lay great chieftain to rest. You do this for Giants and then we know you are friend. Then we give you goblin key and help you fight goblins!
Omar thanks you. When you return we will trade and then discuss plan to crush the Goblins!
No, I will not do this task. Consider this your death sentence, for I will now take this key from you by force, giant!

You retrieve chieftain's skull from Thorndike camp and return with it so we can lay great chieftain to rest. You do this for Giants and then we give you key. If you no do task, we not give key. Giants do not trust humans, even if friend Erubor says so.
Fine. I will do this task and return.
When you return with skull, we will trade. Then you will leave our village and never return or we break you, human.
I am tired of performing favors for everyone. Instead I will just take what I need by force! Prepare to die, giant!
I have returned with your Chieftain's skull.
We will return his skull to his body and Chieftain will be at rest.
You now may get key from Chest, then all is done. You take key and leave. Giants have no futher business with you, human.
Yes, $ is our friend and we will help you. You have my permission to remove key from chest.

Now Giants will also help you fight Goblins. Only way into Citadel is through front gate but Goblins will attack you with great numbers. Giants will come to your aid when this happens. We help smash Goblin defense. But Giants not follow you inside because we too big.
Go now. Giants will know when you move on Goblin Citadel. Giants will be by your side, friend.
Human! Come closer, we have much to discuss.
Human, don't be a fool. Come and talk with me.
Gramuk! I have come to destroy you and right that which has been wronged.
So you have. Well then, let us not delay this inevitable confrontation. I have much to do and the sooner I deal with you, the better.

Human, I have watched you. I have witnessed all your deeds and I know the quest that you have undertaken. Before you foolishly attempt something that you will regret, let us talk. Certainly there is a solution to all this that we may both benefit from.
I will listen for just a moment. Do not try anything foolish.
Human, let me inquire: are you trying to be the savior of all of Thaermore, or are you simply trying to save yourself? The difference means everything.

You see human, you are merely a pawn. Erubor has convinced you that you must destroy me to ensure your own survival, but that is not the case. He is not concerned for your wellbeing. He is only concerned for Shadowmirk and Thaermore. He will readily sacrifice you in hopes of protecting these lands. After all, it was he who sent you foolishly into the heart of the Goblin lands all alone. It is only by my lenience that you stand here now, and it is my overwhelming generosity that persuades me to make you an offer.

It is a simple offer really, one that you can ill afford to turn down: you give me the Crux of Ages and I will let you leave the Citadel unharmed with enough gold to last you the rest of your life. Then you must leave Thaermore and never return. Thaermore will continue to fall into Goblin controll as our insurgency spreads. If you ever return to Thaermore we will look upon you as our enemy, just as all humans are.
Sure. Please continue, I want to hear more...
You are the one trying to deceive me. I have heard enough! Your scourge ends now!
Well then, let us not delay this confrontation. I have much to do and the sooner I deal with you, the better.
I have heard enough! You must pay for your crimes against Thaermore!
Well then, let us not delay this inevitable confrontation. I have much to do and the sooner I deal with you, the better.
I have no loyalty to Thaermore. I agree to your offer.
Well now, dispite the overwhelming imprudence of the race of men, you have shown there is hope for your kind.
Now human, give me the Crux of Ages.
I agree to your offer, but I do not possess the Crux of Ages.
What?! You have not recovered the Crux?
Well then, human, I withdraw my offer.

Now to deal with you, human. You of course realize I could do anything I wanted with you now that I have the Crux. In fact, it would be an expected ending to your quest if I was to withdraw my offer and destroy you right here, but that is not to happen. Goblins are not the deceitful monsters you humans claim we are. You will receive the gold I offered you, as well as your freedom.
Follow me human...

Well hello there, friend. Do you remember me? I'm the guy back in Blackwater who paid you to bring me back a pendant from Lilith. Do you know what I just discovered? I just discovered that you helped yourself to some property down in the Repository that belonged to me.
There is really no need to lie about it because the Vault Master has already identified you as the person who opened vault 15. That vault, and everything in it, belongs to me.
No I didn't take anything! I only looked in the vault!

Are you calling me stupid? Do you think I believe that? Unfortunately for you I don't know what the contents of the vault were before you decided to take a peek, so I have to assume that took something. After all, you are a murderer so how can I trust you?
This isn't going to be very pleasant for you, friend.
Yep, that was me. That equipment is mine now.
Well, at least he is honest about it!
Unfortunately for you, I will be taking back my property now.
Yes I did and I am sorry. Please, take back these items and here's another 100 gold for your trouble.
Groveling is so pathetic, especially coming from a murderer. Besides, our negotiations ended in Blackwater.
Dear boy, who are you?
$, I am Chancellor Malcolm. I...I am sorry. I am a bit confused right now. I feel as though I have just awoken from a very long sleep.
I can remember...something about the Orakur. But that is not right. The Orakur had nothing to do with...
The Crux of Ages. It has been returned, has it not? I feel its presence here in the Spire. My boy, are you responsible for returning it?
I don't know where to begin. There are many questions that will need answered. However, I am sure of one thing: the people of Thaermore owe you everything.

While the Crux was missing, I felt an evil presence here in the Spire. There was something influencing me from afar. I can't quite...remember, but I feel as though I had no control of my own thoughts. I have done a great many wrongs to the people of Thaermore. We have much rebuilding to do.

No more delays! I must summon the Council at once! $, we will have many questions for you. I'm afraid you will be sequestered here in the Spire for a time, but I will see to it that your stay is comfortable.
Send more troops. Send all we have. Now is not the time to question my authority or judgement!

Hello there, welcome to my House of Pain! My name is Sonya and I am a certified Weapons Master.  Are you looking to train in a particular field of weaponry? I teach people the schools of Swordsmanship, Cleaving weapons and Bludgeoning weapons.
Looking to increase your knowledge in weapon use?
I am interested in Cleaving weapon training.
I am interested in Bludgeoning weapon training.

Greetings! My name is Aaron. Perhaps I could interest you in a lesson in archery or thrown weapons? I am a certified Range Master, so you'll be learning from the best! In these hard times, you really should know a little something about protecting yourself from danger at a distance.
Hey there! Anytime you want a lesson in ranged combat, just let me know!
Yes, I'd like to learn a bit more about thrown weapons.
Yes, I'd like to know more about archery.
Oh, hello. My name is Penelope. Can I help you with something?
Please, I am not in the mood for visitors so do not stay long
Is there something I can help you with?
No thanks, I'll just help myself.
Penelope, I found a letter that I believe was meant for you.
Where did you find this?
I am new in town. I was hoping maybe you could tell me a bit about Blackwater.
Blackwater is an old mining town, but not much mining is done in these parts anymore. We are mostly just a stronghold now; the city has been locked down to protect us from marauding goblins and such.

I came here just before the start of the war. I was going to learn to be a gem cutter but since the mining has stopped, I have had to find other work. Now I am just a seamstress and I barely make enough to afford clothes of my own. I haven't even left the walls of this city for over a year.

I just stay here in my house most days, which has become difficult because of the horrible stench coming from across the street. I have complained to the city officials but no one has looked into yet.
In Crakamir. There was a destroyed caravan strewn about the desert. I found this letter among human remains.

Oh my...my poor brother! I hadn't heard from him for such a long time. Nearly a month ago he wrote me and said he would be coming to Blackwater soon, but that was all he said. I assumed he hadn't even left Tarel yet.
Well, that does it. I have no more family left. With brother gone I am now all alone.
Thank you for you efforts to bring me this letter. Here is 10 gold, well more postage than is needed for the delivery of a single letter, but you deserve it.
Thank you. Given your loss, this is more than generous.
No way. I risked my life to bring you this damn letter. You owe me a lot more than 10 gold...
But sir, I have no more! You look as if you are doing very well for yourself, so why do you want to take from someone who has so little. I am a seamstress and make no more than 2 gold a day!
I am sorry. Thank you for the gold.
Look, I don't care. I have problems way bigger than what you are experiencing. I expect a bigger payment and I will gladly find something here in your house worth taking.

Welcome to the Magick Guild of Blackwater. I am Siam the Guildmaster. The guild is not accepting members at this time due to the ongoing conflict, but I can sell you magick supplies and Elemental magick training if you are interested.
So what is it I can do for you?
Thanks for shopping here at the Magicks Guild.
I'd like to know more about Elemental magick.
Thank you for inquiring about training here at the guild.
What has happened to the Magick Guild?

The Magick Guild used to be headquartered in Shadowmirk, the great Mage Hall of the North. After the war began, most of the guild members fled Thaermore. Erubor, head of Shadowmirk, locked down the tower to protect the acolytes who remained there. The defense of Shadowmirk is in their hands now.

It's not that the guild has formally disbanded, we just have no structure at the moment. There is almost no communication with Shadowmirk now, and the guilds located in Vela and Elderhollow are gone. Here in Blackwater, I sell supplies and training to keep this guild branch open until we can reestablish ourselves.

Well, well! Greetings to you traveler! I have not seen you 'round Blackwater before, so I assume you are new to our quaint town. I am William, Council Head of Blackwater. I see to the day-to-day operations here, ensuring security to our townspeople during these rough times.
What is it I can do for you today?
So what is it I can do for you today, traveler?
What can you tell me about Blackwater?

Blackwater is just an old mining town and nothing more, but not much mining goes on 'round these parts anymore. With the war going on we just decided it would be best to lock the city down. We use the gate tax to support our own militia in case the Orakur try to attack us.

I know you're just another adventurer that is come to town to buy some supplies and sell some junk you scavenged from a battlefield, so let me give you a bit of advice: you'd be smart to not go snooping around Blackwater too much. We are serious about our security and the guards will be watching you.

This war is about the most absurd thing I have ever come to know. First we are told the Orakur are out to get us, stealin' the Crux and what not. Then, the Goblins show up and start raiding our towns and villages. Now we've got Barrea Mercenaries coming in from the far west, and no one seems to know what they are doing here or what they're up to. I'll tell you, some days I just feel like the whole world is coming to an end. It's only gonna get a whole lot worse before it gets any better.
I'm sure you were hoping for more information than that, with me being a public official and all, but I really don't know any more about it than you probably do.
Do you know if there is any work available in town?

Well, you can check with the local merchants and see if they have any odd jobs, but you'll find no full-time employment here in Blackwater. Times are tough and even skilled laborers are doing menial jobs just to keep a bit of gold on in their pockets.

But, since you are looking for work and you appear to have an adventurous spirit, I may be able to offer you a mission of sorts. There have been rumors that a mercenary group has been seeking to assassinate me with hopes of taking over operations in Blackwater. Of course, this cannot be allowed to happen. If you were to investigate this matter and bring me proof of their plot, I could give you a reward.
Is this something you would be able to look into?
That's great. The guards have told me that they have seen suspicious individuals outside the city to the southwest, so you may want to start your search there.
No, that problem belongs to people of Blackwater, not me.
Very well. It may be best to not speak of this to anyone else. I don't want the townsfolk to have to worry about such things.
I have found a note that is evidence of a plot to kill you.
Let me see that.
This is exactly what I feared. Well, I assume you took care of the Mercenaries who held this note. If I could only know who set this hit up!
Well, I've got no worries about it right this minute. Here, let me get you a bit of coin from the city's coffer. You deserve this.
Oh, hello! You startled me. My name is Hesham. I'm sorry, if you are here to visit a loved one, the inner crypt is currently closed. I don't know when, or if, the inner crypt will ever be reopened.
Now if you'll pardon me for being so rude, I have to ask you to leave. I am currently working on a very important project and don't have time for visitors.
I'm very busy. Please, just leave. The inner crypt is closed.

Well, if you must know, I am working on a project for Leurik. See, we are running out of capacity in our crematorium and he has asked me to come up with a way to mass incinerate bodies. Cremating bodies one at a time in the furnace is just too slow.

I think I have a formula about finished, but I need a special enzyme that will enhance the scattering property of the combusting fuel. Unfortunately, I just discovered that the enzyme I am looking for is only present in certain insect larvae. I don't have time to gather thousands of larvae needed to extract the few drops of enzyme. I guess I'll have to find an alternate ingredient, but that means the fuel is not going to be nearly as potent.
Yes, so it appears. Look, I need to get back to work. I'm sure you can show yourself out.
Is there anything I could do for you?
Well, I don't know. I need larvae and you don't look like the type of person who would want to spend hours gathering a bag full of larvae for me.
Well, unless you happened to find some very large larvae, then I'd maybe only need 10 or so to get enough enzyme for this concoction.
Sure, I'll keep my eyes peeled for 'giant larvae' to bring back for you.

Well, I appreciate your offer. If you bring me back 10 giant larvae I can finish this mixture. I can't pay you any gold for your services, but I could give you a flask of the finsihed Incineration Fuel. I'm sure you could find something useful to do with it.
I don't have time for larvae gathering. You are on your own.
Uh, yeah. Okay, I need to get back to work. I'm sure you can show yourself out.
I need access to the inner chamber immediately. I have permission from Leurik.
Well, help yourself. You'll need the key which I think Leurik keeps in his office, but I am not going back to the inner crypt with you. There's, uh, well it's not very safe. You're on your own.
Now I must get back to by research. Good day to you.
I have found 10 Hive Larvae. Can you use these?
Yes, yes! Those will do nicely! Hang on, this won't take long at all.
Perfect! The enzyme has lowered the vicosity of the oils. This will burn splendidly!
Here, take this for your efforts. Be very careful with it because it is extremely volatile. I'm sure you'll be able to come up with some creative use for it.
